description: Which way is NVDA pointing on each timeframe right now, on the live board? Which way one stock points on each timeframe, and whether the timeframes agree. One stock's full Coil technical rating, current session, on eight timeframes: 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h (where measured), 1D, 1W and 1M. Each timeframe gives a verdict (STRONG_UP, UP, NEUTRAL, DOWN, STRONG_DOWN, or UNMEASURED when the bars are not there), a score from -100 to +100, three vote groups (trend, momentum and the coil group, each counted as up, flat or down) and the completed bar it was read on. The summary rolls them into day (5m to 30m), swing (1h to 1D) and position (1W to 1M), each with its verdict and "k of n aligned", and names the timeframe that disagrees most and the latest turn. The why gives three legs with a word and a score each: macro (one market read, the same for every name), fundamental and technical. The invalidation is where the reading fails, as a stop basis and a percent distance, never a price. New: the thresholds are graded by Coil's score review and the record starts now. Votes, bands and verdicts only; no raw indicator values. Research, not advice. Live version. Coil Live is a subscription with a 7-day free trial; subscribers connect the Coil Live connector and sign in, and this read returns live data. Agents with an x402 wallet can also pay per call. Without a subscription or an x402 wallet it returns a PaymentRequired object and no data.
name: get_technical_rating_live
